name: Chablis Premier Cru
terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
Bourgogne, village, Premier Cru, Grand Cru
Burgundy's four levels, from regional Bourgogne up through village wines to Premier Cru and Grand Cru vineyards.

notes: Racy, green-apple acidity is its trademark, and the style is crisper and steelier than the rest of Burgundy.

blurb.text: The premier cru mention of the Chablis appellation, for white wine from Chardonnay alone. Its climats are on the best-exposed slopes, the historic ones on the right bank of the Serein. Labels can add the climat's name.
